_comment: The quiver, curated for the public quiver page from 02-Gear/Owned-and-Wishlist.md (2026-08-30). Volumes are ESTIMATES on an unvalidated anchor per the gear audit -- the Rosa's 34.29L matches Christenson's published stock figure, not a measurement of this board. Names here must match breaks.json ladders and test_brief.py's OWNED_BOARDS.

boards.name: 5'4 Mini-Simmons
boards.fins: Glassed-on quad -- no tuning, and a fin ding is a real repair
boards.range: Ankle to shoulder-high on a clean face
boards.role: The planing hull. Speed-first -- its limits are takeoff steepness and surface texture, not wave height. Draw long lines and trim high; it doesn't do vertical and doesn't want to. Genuinely bad on a steep late drop and on wind-textured faces.

boards.name: 5'8 Fish
boards.fins: Captain Fin McCallum single-tab twin keels
boards.role: Thick, full foil -- carries more than the Rosa despite four fewer inches. The catch-everything small-day board, and the one that duck-dives through a short-period conveyor belt.

boards.name: 6'0 Surfer Rosa
boards.fins: Futures thruster only -- F8 Legacy Large
boards.role: The performance thruster. Steep takeoffs, fast walls, vertical surfing -- the assigned Scripps and Mission board. Runs small; minimum viable float, nothing spare.

boards.name: 6'5 Egg
boards.fins: True Ames TA Twin, optional 2.5" trailer
boards.range: Chest to head, glide + paddle power
boards.role: The float king. The most forgiving board in the rack -- shadowed small days, paddle-heavy lineups, any day you want waves handed to you.

boards.name: 7'0 CI Waterhog
boards.role: Soft top with a glassed bottom, so it still has real glide. Zero-consequence days, guests, shorebreak, OB Pier as often as not.

boards.name: 7'6 Magic
boards.fins: True Ames Skip Frye 6.5" and 7.5" single, optional side bites
boards.range: Chest to overhead trim -- points and long walls
boards.role: Trim and glide. Thin for its length, so it's not a paddle machine and it is NOT a step-up -- 'not the tool when the canyon is doubling a 16-second swell.' PB Point is nearly its job description.

boards.name: 9'0 Ron Jon
boards.fins: 2+1 -- FCS II Flow (marked 9.0) + plastic side bites
boards.role: No anxiety attached. The board that gets lent, dinged, and left on racks without a second thought.

boards.name: 9'4 Pink Panther
boards.role: The log. Small point walls and soft peelers -- Cardiff at waist-high, small Swami's, the Shores when you'd rather walk than pump.

boards.name: 11'0 Chris Craft
boards.role: The glider. It doesn't need waves, just water -- flat-spell mornings at the Shores and Cardiff are what you own it for.
